dedupe_keys.name: digital atlas of micronesia infrastructure layers for chuuk roads bridges and other theme maps

description: The Digital Atlas of Micronesia, run by the Island Research and Education Initiative (iREi), is the main source of maps and geospatial data for the Federated States of Micronesia, with a web GIS and searchable database of hundreds of layers on land, reefs, water, vegetation, population, infrastructure, conservation and culture. The Chuuk infrastructure page read on 2026-09-28 offers, among other transport and infrastructure maps, the road network of the islands in Chuuk Lagoon (major roads only, extracted by iREi in 2020 from OpenStreetMap) and the major bridges and causeways (digitised by iREi in 2020 from 2016 WorldView-2 satellite imagery supplied through the US Department of Agriculture), each with a map download, a data download, a layer view and metadata. Coverage is Chuuk State. Access is free; no licence is stated on the page, and derived OpenStreetMap layers carry the ODbL. Caveats: layers are small-island compilations of 2020 and road coverage is limited to major roads. It supports hazard exposure and access studies of island road links, bridges and causeways under storm surge and sea level rise. No related Micronesian infrastructure record is catalogued.
